title: EntrenoApp: Gym Workout
shortDescription: Workouts that fit your time. Log sets, weights and reps. See your progress.
fullDescription:
Your workout routine, tailored to the time and equipment you have.

EntrenoApp helps you know what to train today and keep a record of what you do. Set up a week around your goal, experience, available days and equipment, or enter your own routine.

A PLAN THAT FITS YOUR DAY
- See today's workout.
- Choose a normal, express or gentle version.
- Train at the gym or with the equipment you have at home.

LOG EVERY SET
- Enter weights and reps.
- Mark the sets you complete.
- Time your rest periods.
- Use previous records as a reference.

REVIEW YOUR PROGRESS
Check saved sessions, recorded training volume and changes in the weights you log. Your history reflects the work you have completed.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Create a routine and use basic workout logging without signing up. Workout records are stored on your device, and you can export a copy from Settings.

PLUS IS OPTIONAL
Your routine and basic workout logging remain free. EntrenoApp Plus adds workout adaptation, weekly reviews and advanced progress analysis through an optional subscription.

You do not need to start with a perfect session: choose a shorter or gentler version and save what you complete.
